qwen2.5.name: Qwen 2.5 (7B/32B/72B)

proficiencies.thinking_and_reasoning: 8.8/10 - Superior quantitative logic, mathematical reasoning (MATH), and complex multi-step state tracking.
proficiencies.code_generation_syntax: 9.2/10 - Outstanding performance on HumanEval and MBPP; exceptional code correctness and bracket/syntax accuracy across languages.
proficiencies.compiler_and_debugging: 8.5/10 - High accuracy at diagnosing stack traces, identifying edge-case syntax bugs, and resolving runtime memory/pointer errors.
proficiencies.functional_programming: 8.7/10 - Excellent parsing and generation of functional paradigms, domain-specific configs (Nix, Starlark), and declarative syntax.
proficiencies.hardware_and_embedded_c: 8.3/10 - Strong low-level memory and C/C++ hardware understanding, including register operations, microcontrollers (ESP32/AVR), and build scripts.
proficiencies.system_and_file_navigation: 8.0/10 - Solid knowledge of Linux utilities, bash/shell scripting, and directory structures, with minor tendency to favor dense inline scripts.
proficiencies.information_retrieval_web: 8.1/10 - Capable of processing raw unformatted text blocks and search engine dumps, though occasionally favors concise technical synthesis over broad summaries.
proficiencies.structured_output_json: 9.0/10 - Consistently adheres to strict schema constraints with minimal markdown wrapper noise, ideal for machine-to-machine API output.

best_usecases: Deterministic code generation, refactoring, and AST/Nix/declarative system configuration.
Embedded C/C++ firmware development, microcontroller logic, and hardware registry operations.
Executing sub-agent tasks requiring strict JSON/YAML outputs, code parsing, and structured state mutation.

llama3.1.name: Llama 3.1 (8B/70B/405B)
llama3.1.role: System Orchestrator & Natural Language Reasoning Specialist

proficiencies.thinking_and_reasoning: 8.6/10 - High contextual comprehension, abstract problem decomposition, and macro-level planning across complex multi-agent workflows.
proficiencies.code_generation_syntax: 7.8/10 - Competent generalist code generation, though slightly lower accuracy than Qwen on intricate or niche programming benchmarks.
proficiencies.compiler_and_debugging: 7.6/10 - Good high-level log analysis and logical error detection, though occasionally misses subtle syntax or type-level edge cases.
proficiencies.functional_programming: 7.2/10 - Reliable for standard functional patterns, but requires clearer prompting for strict declarative toolchain configurations like Nix.
proficiencies.hardware_and_embedded_c: 7.0/10 - Strong general system knowledge, though less specialized in vendor-specific embedded C micro-architectures.
proficiencies.system_and_file_navigation: 8.5/10 - Excellent grasp of POSIX environments, shell execution workflows, system administration tasks, and file tree operations.
proficiencies.information_retrieval_web: 8.9/10 - Outstanding long-context comprehension and search output synthesis, effectively filtering noise from raw web search dumps.
proficiencies.structured_output_json: 8.4/10 - Highly reliable when instructed using system prompts, but occasionally adds conversational markdown wrappers unless explicitly restrained.

best_usecases: Top-level orchestration, goal decomposition, and task allocation across downstream worker agents.
Processing, summarizing, and synthesizing messy web search dumps (SearXNG/Crawl) into structured knowledge.
System administration, shell script generation, and high-level architectural document writing.
